method: Every AA/3Di score recomputed with a separate set-membership frequency recurrence on all nodes, including hard multifurcations and unconstrained missing tips. Every site exposure count, model count and all six quantiles recomputed from normalized residue rows.
exhaustive_tests: 243 two-state tip assignments including missing data across three four-tip topologies matched enumeration of all internal/unknown states; additional hard-polytomy, multicolumn and rejection tests passed.
